title: Efficient dye removal using well-crystallized layered double hydroxides and their oxides: insights into kinetics, thermodynamics, isotherm and the memory effect
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50076-50088
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06650F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Saleem Reihana Parveen, Viruthachalam Thiagarajan
High concentrations of metal salts used in hydrothermal synthesis yield well-crystallized Mg–Al LDH/LDO. The resulting LDH/LDO shows pH-independent MO dye adsorption and exhibits a memory effect that enables LDH reconstruction.
